text:
sara-sales: Morning team — kicking off the Lumenix POC. Meeting tomorrow 10:00am PT to align scope and success metrics. cc: @priya-se @devon-se @oliver-csm @kai-lumenix
priya-se: Thanks! Can we lock down success criteria before the meeting? Suggested: 1) retrieval QA > 85% on our eval set 2) p99 latency < 300ms for 256 tokens 3) end-to-end cost target <$0.02 / query
kai-lumenix: Yes to all. Use cases: "internal policy search" and "customer support summarization". Expect ~50 qps during weekday peaks. Data residency: EU only for some docs.
sara-sales: Good — also fielding pricing question from procurement: will Dedicated be needed or can we prove on hosted? procurement prefers predictable commit if cost per q is high.
devon-se: My recommendation: start hosted with a production-like eval harness. If latency/cost/SLA gap shows up, recommend Dedicated reserve in week 3. We'll define 3 eval buckets: quality tests, latency/load tests, resilience/fallbacks.
oliver-csm: I'll gather stakeholders. Need Lumenix list: product eng, infra, security lead, procurement. @kai-lumenix can you share contacts?
kai-lumenix: Sure: me (Kai, POC lead), anna-eng (product), marco-infra, lena-sec, raj-procurement. I'll DM emails after the call.
priya-se: For prompt/eval prep can you share a small sample of documents + 50 golden queries? Also any redlines for PHI/PCI handling. Example quick prompt for retrieval: "Given policy doc X, answer: is remote work allowed for contractors?"
kai-lumenix: We'll export a subset today. No PHI. Some docs are GDPR-sensitive.
priya-se: Example snippet for our test harness (curl):
```
curl https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1.0","input":"<prompt>","max_tokens":256,"stream":true}'
```
priya-se: We can also enable function-calling for structured support case extraction.
security-bot: Lumenix requested SOC2 + KMS. Security checklist: SSO/SCIM, org-level logs, data-at-rest KMS, EU region deployment. See https://redwood.com/security/sales-checklist
kai-lumenix: KMS + EU region required. Also need data retention policy for POC logs.
devon-se: Plan/timeline proposal:
- Week 0: kickoff + contacts + data handoff
- Week 1: ingest subset + build eval harness (quality tests)
- Week 2: integration + latency baseline tests
- Week 3: load tests + cost tuning (batching/quantization)
- Week 4: final report + next steps (Dedicated sizing or contract)
priya-se: Can everyone review and add blockers in this thread before the 10am call? I'll bring prompts/eval template and small demo.
sara-sales: Perfect. @deploy-bot please provision a POC org and temp API key for Lumenix.
deploy-bot: POC org created: org-lumenix-poc-437, temp key sent to @sara-sales via DM. :rocket:
oliver-csm: I'll schedule the invite and include stakeholders. Thanks all.
kai-lumenix: Thanks — see you tomorrow.
